name: dsh-mesh-broker
description: The mesh broker (stream S5 of docs/mesh/71-mesh-program.md): POST /place, POST /done, GET /nodes. It reads every node's GET /mesh/capacity directly over the tailnet with a short timeout, caches for at most 15 s, computes a score and a queue position from live measurements only, and NEVER refuses - with every node at zero slots it still names a node and returns position > 0.
